users.title: Users
users.description: Manage customer access and, as the owner, administrator accounts.

empty.title: No manageable accounts
empty.description: Accounts you are allowed to manage will appear here.
empty.searchDescription: Try a different name or email address.

detail.title: Account details
detail.noSelectionDescription: Choose an account from the ledger to review its details and available actions.

block.title: Block this account?
block.description: The account will be unable to sign in and all current sessions will end.

unblock.title: Unblock this account?
unblock.description: The account will be allowed to sign in again.

revokeSessions.title: Revoke all sessions?
revokeSessions.description: Every signed-in device for this account will need to sign in again.

sendPasswordReset.title: Send a password-reset email?
sendPasswordReset.description: A time-limited setup link will be sent to this account. No password will be shown or set here.

promote.title: Promote to administrator?
promote.description: This account will gain customer-management access. Existing sessions will end before the new role can take effect.

demote.title: Demote to customer?
demote.description: This account will lose administrator access. Existing sessions will end immediately.

invite.title: Invite an administrator
invite.description: Create the account without a password and send a secure, time-limited setup link. The recipient chooses their own password.
invite.name: Name

results.blocked: The account is blocked and its sessions were revoked.
results.sessionsRevoked: All sessions for this account were revoked.
results.promoted: The account was promoted and its sessions were revoked.
results.demoted: The account was demoted and its sessions were revoked.
results.administratorInvited: The administrator account was created and its secure setup email was sent.
results.administratorCreatedDeliveryFailed: The administrator account was created, but the setup email could not be delivered. Open the account and resend the password-reset email.
results.invalidInput: The request was not valid. Review the information and try again.
results.forbidden: You no longer have permission to perform this action.
results.notFound: The account no longer exists or cannot be managed.
results.stale: The account changed after you opened it. Refresh the page and review the latest details.
results.rateLimited: An email was sent recently. Wait a moment before trying again.
results.emailExists: An account with this email already exists.
results.deliveryFailed: The email could not be delivered. Try again later.
